policy: CF-token reconstruction with exact protected literals; whole reading unavailable for missing Han or unsupported script. No phrase-specific overrides.

observations.meaning: Complete Latin output is not a correctness metric. Review found true context-dependent syllable errors, tone-only errors/omissions, a v/umlaut encoding issue, and an ambiguous original message. Legitimate dictionary/regional/underlying-tone conventions are not rejected as pronunciation errors. Audio remains pronunciation authority.
